description: Ownership inventory for the supported Manim-compatible authoring surface.

operations.surface: Circle
operations.reason: Rust constructs the geometry and Manim Cairo VMobject defaults directly in the shared semantic store; Python only coerces explicit host constructor arguments.

operations.surface: Square
operations.reason: Rust constructs square geometry and exact Manim VMobject defaults; Python retains only call-shape and explicit-argument coercion.

operations.surface: Rectangle
operations.reason: Rust constructs rectangle geometry and exact Manim VMobject defaults; Python retains only call-shape and explicit-argument coercion.

operations.surface: Line
operations.reason: Rust constructs line geometry and exact Manim VMobject defaults; Python only coerces endpoint vectors and explicit constructor options.

operations.surface: Detached and animate-target Mobject.shift
Leaf Mobject.move_to for point or leaf-Mobject targets
operations.reason: Python coerces Manim vector arguments; Rust chooses aligned critical points, applies coordinate masks, and performs the translation.

operations.surface: Object move_to/align_to with family targets; live object move_to with family targets
operations.reason: Python forwards typed anchors. Rust observes authored or live effective bounds and commits one local translation. Invalid handles cannot fall back to Python critical-point arithmetic; live align_to remains unsupported.

operations.surface: Detached and animate-target Mobject.scale
Detached and animate-target Mobject.rotate
Detached and animate-target Mobject.set_color/set_fill/set_stroke/set_opacity
Detached and animate-target Mobject.center/width/height/critical_point
Scene-bound Mobject.center/width/height/critical_point
operations.reason: Ordinary layout reads typed shared authored/live observations. Missing typed observations fail explicitly; Python curve extrema and raw bounds fallback are deleted.

operations.surface: Vector-path and Manim-specialized geometry layout bounds
operations.reason: Ordinary layout reads typed shared authored/live observations. Missing typed observations fail explicitly; Python curve extrema and raw bounds fallback are deleted.

operations.surface: Leaf Mobject.next_to without explicit submobject aligner selection
operations.reason: Rust owns Manim's unnormalized direction/buffer formula, aligned critical points, coordinate mask, and translation; Python only coerces host values.

operations.surface: Mobject.next_to with submobject_to_align/index_of_submobject_to_align and Group-family targets
operations.reason: Typed selected-member placement resolves direct family indices, including negative indices, and target/source bounds in Rust. Authored placement and LiveSession::next_layout_to_aligned reuse the same relative-placement math and atomic local mutation vocabulary. Python passes explicit wrapper references and coerces arguments only; legacy/export query fallbacks remain separately inventoried.

operations.surface: Leaf Mobject.align_to/align_on_border
operations.reason: Python coerces vectors/points while Rust chooses critical points and applies axis/frame-edge translations.

operations.surface: Deterministic Group/VGroup aggregate bounds, center, width/height, and critical-point queries
operations.reason: Rust aggregates semantic family membership using authored bounds or current effective runtime transforms through LiveSession. Python only checks local wrapper eligibility; it cannot feed per-leaf bounds or construct a partial observation.

operations.surface: Deterministic Group/VGroup shift/move_to/center/set_x/set_y translation
operations.reason: Rust computes the translation from shared bounds and commits every observed leaf through one alias-aware semantic transaction. Python only coerces arguments and checks wrapper eligibility; it does not refresh a scene-state mirror.

operations.surface: Deterministic Group/VGroup next_to/align_to without explicit submobject selection
operations.reason: Rust resolves family/leaf/point critical points, Manim's unnormalized next_to direction and buffer, align_to axis masking, and the authoritative recursive leaf mutation order. Python only coerces host arguments and selects the target handle kind.

operations.surface: Group/VGroup authored and live move_to/next_to/align_to with selected-member anchors
operations.reason: Family observations, selected anchors and relative-placement math are shared Rust operations. Live placement reads effective bounds and uses the same local mutation transaction. Python passes wrapper references and coerces vector/index arguments; remaining explicit legacy snapshot fallback is separately inventoried.

operations.surface: Detached Mobject.become/replace
Canonical Group.animate/ApplyMethod/ScaleInPlace over ordinary semantic leaves
operations.reason: Rust validates authoritative family topology/order and lowers one shared composition. Live target families publish through the existing session; Python retains wrapper identity and call coercion.

operations.surface: Canonical leaf/family Indicate with default restoring timing
operations.reason: Python passes an inert handle/options request. Rust captures effective state, computes family-center scaling, lowers shared restoring time maps and rejects conflicting center dependencies atomically.

operations.surface: Supported Transform and animate target requests
operations.reason: Supported Transform and animate target intent reaches shared Rust execution. Constructor-only unsupported variants no longer have a Python playback fallback.

operations.surface: Typed leaf FadeIn/FadeOut with scale, shift, or target_position
operations.reason: Python coerces the Manim call into scale plus a shift or point value. Rust resolves effective endpoint layout, authors the affine and appearance tracks, owns lifecycle membership, and schedules composition timing.

operations.surface: Typed Group/VGroup FadeIn/FadeOut opacity and lifecycle, including compositions with Text Write
operations.reason: Rust traverses authoritative family leaves, applies shared composition timing, validates conflicts atomically and owns family root introduction/removal. Python passes handles and coerced options; affine family fade endpoints remain unsupported.

operations.surface: Typed leaf DrawBorderThenFill and forward ordinary-vector Write families
operations.reason: Python coerces Manim outline options and wrapper identity. Rust derives the activation-effective outline and final style, owns both phases and family lag scheduling, and publishes detached families atomically.

operations.surface: Plain Text and Group/VGroup Text Write/Unwrite, including mixed ordinary compositions
operations.reason: Python passes typed Text/family handles and explicit options. Rust derives global glyph order and count-dependent defaults, validates composition conflicts and membership atomically, and publishes compact per-leaf global spans with immutable glyph plans to the common renderer.

operations.surface: Plain Text and Text/geometry Group/VGroup Create/Uncreate, including mixed ordinary compositions
operations.reason: Python passes typed handles and explicit options. Rust owns global glyph ordering, Reveal defaults, local rate reversal, atomic family membership and conflicting-driver validation. The existing compact glyph plans and common retained renderer realize both Create/Uncreate and Write/Unwrite.

operations.surface: ShowIncreasingSubsets and ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne for ordinary direct-member families
operations.reason: Python validates constructor ergonomics and passes one family handle and mode. Rust atomically prepares paint opacity, admits detached direct members, resolves exact ordered thresholds, lowers typed Fill/Stroke tracks, and reconciles absolute endpoints.

operations.surface: Supported FadeIn/FadeOut/Create/Uncreate lifecycle requests
operations.reason: Supported lifecycle requests use shared Rust execution and atomic publication; the Python lifecycle planner, snapshot scheduling and presence-track mutation hooks are deleted.

operations.surface: AnimationGroup/LaggedStart/LaggedStartMap/Succession
operations.reason: Python builds inert recursive requests; the shared Rust operation owns timing, lifecycle and time maps. The obsolete Python scheduler, rollback and flattened-track construction are deleted.

operations.surface: Animation and Scene.play timing/rate options
Single-leaf GrowFromPoint/Center/Edge, SpinInFromNothing and ShrinkToCenter
Mobject.animate shift/set_fill/scale/rotate target edits
Group.animate target derivation
operations.reason: Rust copies the complete semantic family in one transaction, preserving ordered edges and internal aliases. Live copies capture coherent effective leaf state. Python prepares class/attribute metadata and binds the returned typed copies; it does not construct target nodes or edges.

operations.surface: Deterministic scene-bound Mobject transform/style/layout state and animate source seed
operations.reason: The same store-owned semantic node survives initial scene binding and owns deterministic transform/style/layout state. Target editors allocate independent nodes in that store. The canonical path lowers directly to ExecutionSession; the obsolete Python animation completion synchronizer is deleted.

operations.surface: Detached semantic state
operations.reason: Detached wrappers require shared Rust construction; Python retains no raw geometry state and rejects raw replacement.

operations.surface: Detached and fresh deterministic scene-bound Mobject.copy / animate target seed
operations.reason: Fresh detached and deterministic bound wrappers clone the shared handle directly; source state does not cross the bridge as JSON during copy or animate target construction.

operations.surface: Callback-bound copy and target capture
operations.reason: Outside an active callback phase, copies use the shared live target editor; missing/stale handles and active-phase copies fail without snapshot materialization.

operations.surface: Group/VGroup direct family identity, membership, and order
operations.reason: The shared semantic store assigns stable object/family identities, owns duplicate suppression and direct-member order, and returns membership decisions that Python mirrors for wrapper identity.

operations.surface: Python Group wrapper references and leaf iteration
operations.reason: Python retains object references for Manim class/protocol identity, but membership transitions are accepted or rejected by the shared family handle before this mirror changes.
operations.replacement: Keep the wrapper mirror as host-language identity metadata; deterministic family semantics remain shared.

operations.surface: Scene.add/play/wait cursor and lifecycle authoring
operations.reason: All valid scene operations use shared Rust continuations; the Python Scene/document engine, cursor, tracks, snapshots and scheduling have been deleted. Derived wrapper identities remain Python metadata.

operations.surface: Scene.remove/replace/clear and top-level ordering
operations.reason: One shared Rust planner validates and atomically applies family-aware add/remove/clear/replace requests and owns authoritative root painter order. Python reserves derived wrapper identities, submits one typed request, and maps the ordered Rust projection back to public wrappers after success.

operations.surface: Group/VGroup arrange with edge, coordinate mask, explicit/indexed aligners and shared family aliases
operations.reason: One shared planner resolves direct-member selections, observes local leaf bounds, stages successive placements against preceding moves and centers unique semantic leaves once. Authored and live options calls publish one atomic transaction. Python passes one typed options object without sequencing member placements or supplying bounds.

operations.surface: Known Manim rate-function callable lookup
operations.reason: Python must map a callable object to a stable shared semantic identifier; numerical evaluation belongs to Rust.
operations.replacement: Emit the identifier to the shared resolver.

operations.surface: Mobject.add_updater/remove_updater/clear_updaters
operations.reason: Arbitrary user callback code is intentionally executed by the host language through the callback bridge.

operations.surface: ValueTracker, native signal, and property-binding declarations
operations.reason: Python normalizes Manim call shapes and carries shared Rust handles. It has no fallback scalar value, signal allocator, reactive document or alternate playback hook.
operations.replacement: Keep the adapter thin and route any new deterministic reactive policy into Rust.

operations.surface: Reactive graph validation, evaluation, invalidation, and native input dispatch
Authored and live Group/VGroup color, fill, stroke and opacity
operations.reason: Rust selects unique leaves and stages one validated transaction using existing leaf paint operations. Existing active callback per-leaf dispatch remains under #955 until shared family callback overlay operations replace it; this row covers persistent authoring only.

operations.surface: Group/VGroup arrange_in_grid rows, columns and spacing
operations.reason: The existing Rust layout planner owns membership, per-row/column dimensions, sequential alias handling, center preservation and atomic translation. Python only coerces dimensions/gaps and forwards one authored/live call. Active callback family layout remains unsupported under #955.

operations.surface: Authored and live Group/VGroup scale and rotate with aliased semantic members
operations.reason: Rust resolves family pivots and unique leaf identity, reuses shared object affine operations, and stages one atomic transaction. Live edits preserve publication/driver guards; Python only coerces arguments and selects authored or live forwarding. Paint and grid remain separate work under #61.

operations.surface: Object/family width and height fitting and matching
operations.reason: Rust owns current bounds, dimension ratios, unique family leaves and atomic affine publication. Python forwards typed layout references and coerces arguments. Active callback fitting and rotated nonuniform stretching are explicitly unsupported.
